tests.transport: Real official Client sessions over spawned stdio server process

initial_campaign.scope: Protocol discovery/parity, revocation, hidden/malformed calls, immutable identity/task/policy scope before framing/launch-file hardening

findings.basis: Source-level observation: initial loader used stat(path) followed by open(path), allowing pathname replacement between checks and read. No production exploit claimed.
findings.correction: O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC|O_NONBLOCK; fstat and bounded read on same opened regular-file descriptor; owner/no-group/world-write check.

findings.basis: Installed SDK stdio reader iterates unbounded text lines before JSON parsing.
findings.correction: BoundedInput limits each frame to 65536 bytes before JSON parse; preserves official SDK stdio framing/output transport.

controls: Current canonical host authority at discovery and invocation
No stage seal or completion authority
No custody reconciliation or arbitrary path/shell tools
No blanket readOnlyHint because host clock admission checkpoint persists
limitations: Trusted launcher and protected config parent/DB/root remain host OS obligations
SDK lowlevel handle used only in pinned stream runner; SDK updates require compatibility regression
Lifecycle mutations unexposed pending qualified host gate evaluator
descriptor_coherence: Discovery projects exact closed/bounded argument models; real SDK client asserts closed inspect/handoff schemas and nested handoff closure.
prior_18_case_witness: evidence/mcp_initial18.json retained before descriptor metadata correction; same18 cases rerun with schema assertions.
